name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack.
Lower the bar to mid-chest under control.
Press back up until arms are straight.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower until the dumbbells are beside your chest, then press up.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, body in a straight line.
Push back up to the start.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and step forward.
With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Dips
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight.
Lower until upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the start.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height, grip just outside shoulders.
Brace and press the bar straight overhead.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Grip the bar or rope at chest height, elbows at your sides.
Push down until arms are straight.
Let it rise back to chest height without moving your elbows.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend the arms back to the start.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way down with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pads and grip the bar wide.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Return slowly until arms are straight.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, bar hanging at arm's length.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower under control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet on the platform.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand and knee on a bench.
Row the dumbbell to your hip.
Lower it until your arm is straight.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar, back flat, chest up.
Drive through the floor and stand tall.
Lower the bar by pushing the hips back.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding the bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar to your shoulders, elbows still.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl them up without rotating your wrists.
Lower with control.

name: Back Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width.
Sit down and back until thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest.
Squat between your knees, chest tall.
Stand back up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower the sled until knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking your knees.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot into the next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest your back foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive up through the front foot.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower shins.
Extend your legs until straight.
Lower slowly.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height.
Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your thighs with a flat back.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower with control.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, bar over your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Lower and repeat.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Lower until you feel a stretch.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley, holding the rope beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Return slowly.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Rotate your torso side to side, touching the floor beside each hip.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge and hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and repeat.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at arm's length.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower slowly.
